title: Are compounded GLP-1 products still allowed after shortage resolution?
claim: Compounded tirzepatide and semaglutide are still legal now that the shortages are over.
correct_wording: FDA resolved the national shortages of tirzepatide (Dec. 19, 2024) and semaglutide (Feb. 21, 2025). After transition periods, compounded copies are generally subject to the usual 503A/503B copy restrictions; local stock-outs do not create a continuing shortage.
why_confusion: Patients may still see intermittent pharmacy stock issues and mistakenly believe the national shortage continues.
